name: bpmn-analyst
description: AI Business-Analyst that turns a vague request into a valid BPMN 2.0 model

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build -w @bpmn-analyst/server && node packages/server/dist/index.js
